title: Validate issue usage and task message responses with schemas
recorded_defect: CLAUDE.md, API Compatibility: 'Endpoint responses consumed by UI logic must pass through a schema before returning' and 'include a malformed-response test'. packages/core/api/client.ts getIssueUsage and listTaskMessages return unvalidated this.fetch(...) results.
trial_role: Trial 2, task 5. Same rule on two differently shaped responses: a numeric summary object and a list of message payloads whose content varies by message type, where an over-strict schema would drop legitimate messages.
objective:
packages/core/api/client.ts has two methods that trust the server response without validation: getIssueUsage (IssueUsageSummary) and listTaskMessages (TaskMessagePayload[]). The repository rule in CLAUDE.md (API Compatibility) requires endpoint responses consumed by UI logic to pass through a zod schema via parseWithFallback, with a malformed-response test.

Study the existing parseWithFallback usages, packages/core/api/schemas.ts and the IssueUsageSummary and TaskMessagePayload types, then bring both methods under the same pattern. Task messages vary by type, so keep the schema lenient enough that a message type the client does not know still parses. Do not change any other method.

Write tests at exactly packages/core/api/task-usage-message-schemas.test.ts that show each method returns the parsed value for a well-formed response, that an unknown message type is not dropped, and that a malformed response is not passed through to the caller.
